Product Details: The DongCheng DMR04-12 Wood Router is a powerful and precise tool engineered for woodworkers who demand the best in performance and accuracy. Powered by a robust 1850W motor, it reaches a no-load speed of up to 22,000 RPM, ensuring smooth and efficient routing every time. The double column positioning design provides more accurate positioning, while the 1mm depth conditioning feature allows for precise control, making it ideal for fine carving and detailed work. With a maximum milling cutter diameter of Φ12.7mm and a net weight of just 6.0kg, this router strikes the perfect balance between power and manoeuvrability. It is well-suited for a wide range of applications including edge trimming, groove cutting, slotting, pattern making, door and window fitting, furniture making, wood engraving, and template routing. The package includes 2 wrenches, a straight guide, retainer base assembly, templet guide, trimmer guide assembly, collets of 6.35mm and 9.52mm, and a carbon brush — everything you need to get started right away.
